comparator.name: Sociology (Sociologie)
comparator.sourceNotes: Tilburg’s current official 2026–27 curriculum accounts for exactly 180 ECTS. Year 1 is a fixed 60-ECTS sociology foundation. Year 2 combines 36 ECTS of common methods, philosophy and research with the 24-ECTS Grootstedelijke Vraagstukken major. The selected non-exchange Year 3 route contains a 12-ECTS placement, an 18-ECTS minor, 12 ECTS of compulsory Sociology electives, a 12-ECTS thesis and 6 ECTS of Social Philosophy. This is the published route used to complete the curriculum without inventing exchange or elective content.

comparatorRouteSelection.basis: The normalized target is Tilburg’s Dutch Sociology bachelor, which focuses on Dutch society. Of the three published majors, Grootstedelijke Vraagstukken is the Dutch-taught route and directly continues the programme’s stated attention to Dutch cities, inequality, exclusion and the welfare state. It is selected independently of UCR fit.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest programme uses the complete available UCR sociology sequence and a strong mixed-method social-research spine. The culture/identity/migration and social-risks/health/sustainability directions are independently supported by generator-eligible programme interests and the official curriculum, produce substantively different course choices, and pass feasibility and pairwise distinctness. notes.text: Tilburg Sociology provides a continuous disciplinary sequence in theory, qualitative and quantitative methods, survey construction, causal analysis, major-specific courses, sociological research projects and a 12-ECTS thesis. UCR offers a coherent sociology core and strong related study in politics, history, psychology, economics, media and research methods, but it does not reproduce the same continuous specialist sociology sequence.

UCR does not reproduce Tilburg’s dedicated survey-construction course, full causal-analysis sequence, 12-ECTS second-year sociological research project, complete Metropolitan Social Issues major, placement structure or 12-ECTS sociology thesis. Those differences remain explicit rather than being filled with weak substitutes.
The selected Tilburg Sociology route is Dutch-taught, while UCR is English-taught. The comparison assesses academic content and structure rather than language eligibility.
